rule_bindings.interpretation: Candidate synthetic in-scope Board-regulated state member bank using standardized treatment; no CBLR election and no excluded covered position.
Company exposure satisfying the dated corporate definition; all fourteen numbered exclusions assessed. Generic BCBS labels cannot decide this.
Ordinary on-balance-sheet exposure measured using applicable GAAP carrying value, without double subtracting allowance/write-offs. Type EXPOSURE_AMOUNT.
Candidate 1.00 for ordinary corporate under (f)(1), with (f)(2)-(3), (k), CRM and other treatments screened.
Use the regulatory exposure measure times the applicable risk weight for single-exposure RWA.
Product educational transformation at 0.08 using minimum total-capital ratio as reference, not allocated loan capital or a bank-specific requirement.

corroboration.method: Parse existing XML; select each eCFR DIV8's direct P children and the corresponding GovInfo SECTION's direct P children; compare InnerText in document order after removing regex whitespace characters only. No case, punctuation or token rewriting. Comparison is diagnostic; raw source bytes/hashes are unchanged.
corroboration.limitations: Does not compare headings, tables, footnotes, editorial notes, definitions' cross-reference effects or the legal amendment chain. Removing whitespace is not a finding of legal equivalence or a hash-normalization policy.
